ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the recent cases of childcare fraud and follow the money to determine the scope of the issue.
questions: What is the total amount of alleged childcare fraud?
How are the perpetrators using the funds?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and following the money, we may be able to identify a larger pattern of fraud and uncover the perpetrators.
